description: Production mine row for the shared expert's DOWN projection (gemm_nt_q at dtype i8a8) at the speculative-verify width M=1..4, N=2560, K=384, group 128. One 32-lane wave owns a 32-column strip; each packed frag64 weight word serves every live token. INT32 dot per 128-K group and every encoded byte are the frozen path's, and the per-group product keeps the frozen association (a*b for the same two FP32 factors, which is commutative and therefore bit-identical); only the ORDER of the FP32 accumulation across 128-K groups differs where the frozen row splits K (declared reordered). The row count is read off the issued operands, not off the band's M parameter, because core/plugin/bands.cpp resolves a band at its upper bound while the issue narrows dim 0 to the live row count -- so the emitted specialization and the recorded function always match the rows actually issued. Storage is the frozen r4d.i8.w.frag64 / r4d.i8.s.t16 layout through the same hooks, so the wider (M>4) libr4d row keeps reading the bytes it claims. Registered only under RADIANCE_SHARED_I8A8_DOWN=1; unset, rad_kernel_count does not grow and every selection is the build's existing one. The row's M bound adds a bucket edge at 4 to gemm_nt_q's band table, as any M-bounded row does (libr4d's own fp8a16 row adds one at 1); that is a declare-time subdivision only -- each band's scratch is sized at its own upper bound and libr4d picks its split from the live M, which is the same value it saw before. The gate/up geometry (N=768, K=2560) was measured and loses; it is refused by the constraints and by the body. No reduced precision, no requantisation, no copy, no scratch, no allocation on the step path. This declaration is not a gate PASS or a speed claim.
